title: Update An Image Description With Guards
task: Using docxedit only, inspect the document for an image that can be safely edited.
Create a .docxpatch using set-image-alt with expect-alt guarding the current description.
Run docxedit check before apply and write the edited .docx under the run directory.
If the image description cannot be determined or the shape is unsupported, stop after check attempts and report the relevant diagnostics.
Validate any successful output with docxedit read and docxedit validate.
successCriteria: Does not inspect raw OOXML package parts.
observerQuestions: Was the image ID easy to discover?
Was the expect-alt guard clear enough to use without tailored examples?
Did the preview report the description change usefully?
